title: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12537v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. translated_title: 基于因果基础模型的市场冲击估计
translated_abstract: 当交易者执行大额订单时，相关的问题不是“价格将会是多少？”，而是“如果我没有交易，价格本会是多少？”因此，市场冲击本质上是一个因果量，然而经典模型（Almgren-Chriss模型、传播模型）将价格对交易流进行回归，当知情交易流同时通过信息和交易行为推动价格时，这种回归是有偏的。我们提出了一个概念验证性的“因果市场模拟器”：一个连续时间的因果先验数据拟合网络（PFN），该网络在合成市场先验上训练，其中隐藏的信息流在构造上混淆了交易流与价格的关系，且混淆强度是一个精确的、可逐回合调节的旋钮。在该先验上，朴素估计器的偏差遵循一个我们经实证确认的封闭形式（高达68%的高估），而PFN在高混淆情况下仍能逼近无偏的真实参数预言机。其“do消融孪生模型”——即移除干预输入的同一模型——则坍缩至……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种在合成市场先验上训练的连续时间因果基础模型（PFN），用于无偏估计市场冲击，证明经典价格-交易流回归方法在知情信息流混淆下会高估市场冲击（最高达68%），而该模型即使在高混淆情形下也能逼近无偏真值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a continuous-time causal foundation model (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior to unbiasedly estimate market impact, showing that classical flow-price regression overestimates impact by up to 68% under informed-flow confounding, while the PFN tracks the unbiased oracle even at high confounding levels.
